description: Showed the third mark, and said she had shown the first two.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Served the short loaf and would not obey a paper she had not got.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat on the shut chronicle and did not move.
name: Gib

description: Said the three names back and stopped.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Read a psalm-verse and a prayer for the fruits at the marks, and called the forty minutes done.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Kept the three names plain and left the precept as talk.
name: William Shakespeare
